name: _meta
script: return "照片级收藏（暗色）：侧栏切暗色 → 进旅行 → 灯箱收藏按钮变红（title 变「取消收藏」断言）。前置：gen-demo 演示数据。"

name: 02-click-dark
script: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="radiogroup"][aria-label="主题"] button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === '暗'); if (!b) throw new Error('暗色切换按钮缺失'); b.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); if (document.documentElement.dataset.mode !== 'dark') throw new Error('暗色未生效'); 'dark-ok'

name: 04-open-trip
script: const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(el => el.textContent.includes('京都')); if (!h) throw new Error('找不到京都'); h.click(); 'ok'

name: 05-open-lightbox
script: const imgs = document.querySelectorAll('main img'); if (imgs.length < 2) throw new Error('照片不足'); imgs[1].click(); 'ok'

name: 07-fav-in-lightbox
script: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button[title="收藏"]')].pop(); if (!b) throw new Error('灯箱收藏按钮缺失'); b.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); if (![...document.querySelectorAll('button[title="取消收藏"]')].length) throw new Error('收藏状态未更新'); 'fav-ok'
